Phoenix Convention Center Shuttle: Your Complete Conference Transportation Guide

The Phoenix Convention Center hosts major events year-round — from tech conferences to medical symposiums, trade shows to conventions. Whether you're an attendee, exhibitor, or event organizer, navigating downtown Phoenix transportation is part of the equation.

The short answer: Scottsdale Sprinters runs conference shuttles by the hour. An Executive Sprinter (14 seats) is $145/hr with a 4-hour minimum; the Mini Bus (24 Pax) is $185/hr, and the Executive Mini Coach is $225/hr, each with a 4-hour minimum. For 30 to 56 riders the 56-Passenger Motorcoach ($325/hr, 5-hour minimum) takes one load; bigger programs run two or three shuttles in rotation.

For how we plan group movements around larger events, see the Scottsdale event transportation guide.

Transportation Challenges at Major Conferences

The Parking Problem

Downtown Phoenix parking near the convention center:

  • Garages near the convention center fill on major event days
  • Daily garage rates add up over a multi-day conference
  • Walking from remote lots in summer heat
  • Time lost searching for spots

The Rideshare Reality

During major conferences:

  • The fare is set when you request the car
  • Wait times increase dramatically
  • Pickup zones become chaotic
  • Driver quality varies widely

The Professional Solution

Pre-arranged transportation eliminates uncertainty:

  • Scheduled pickups at a rate quoted in writing
  • Consistent driver quality
  • Direct communication with your chauffeur
  • VIP treatment, every time

Individual Executive Transfer

From Scottsdale or Biltmore hotels to the Convention Center

A one-way transfer is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included: $225 on the Luxury SUV or $295 on the Executive Sprinter, before tax. Hotel area doesn't change the price — Old Town, North Scottsdale and Paradise Valley are all the same fare.

Features:

  • Door-to-door service
  • Timing adjusted to your session schedule

VIP Executive Service

For speakers, executives, board members

A dedicated vehicle for the day is simply the hourly rate × hours, with the free-hour rule applied. A 10-hour speaker day on the Executive Sprinter bills 9 hours: $1,305 before tax. On the Maybach Jet Sprinter ($295/hr) the same day is $2,655.

Includes:

  • Meet-and-greet at the airport
  • Dedicated vehicle for the duration
  • Privacy and discretion
  • Flexible scheduling

Sample Conference Scenarios

Scenario 1: Individual Executive (3-day conference)

Staying: The Phoenician, Scottsdale
Needs: Daily transportation to/from the convention center, one dinner event

Transportation Plan (Luxury SUV):

  • Morning transfer: one-way, $225
  • Evening return: one-way, $225 — $450 per day, $1,350 for three days
  • Dinner event (evening 2): a separate 4-hour booking, $500
  • All figures before 8% tax

Scenario 2: Team of 8 (2-day conference)

Staying: Arizona Biltmore
Needs: Morning and evening group transportation

Transportation Plan (Executive Sprinter):

  • Morning transfer $295 + evening return $295 = $590 per day
  • Two days: $1,180 before tax
  • About $148 per person for the whole conference

Scenario 3: Corporate Group (40 attendees, 4-day conference)

Staying: Multiple Scottsdale hotels
Needs: Complete shuttle program

Transportation Plan:

  • 2 Mini Bus (24 Pax) shuttles, 6-hour shifts daily: 2 × $1,110 = $2,220 per day before tax, repeated each conference day
  • That is about $56 per attendee per day with 20 on each shuttle
  • Evening shuttle to an off-site dinner: Executive Mini Coach, 4-hour minimum, $900 (two runs carry the whole group)
  • VIP vehicle for 4 executives: Luxury SUV at $125/hr for the hours needed

Navigating Downtown Phoenix

Key Locations

Convention Center Entrances:

  • Main: Washington Street
  • North Building: 3rd Street
  • South Building: Monroe Street

Nearby Venues:

  • Footprint Center (events, entertainment)
  • Chase Field (Diamondbacks games during season)
  • Symphony Hall
  • Orpheum Theatre

Traffic Patterns

Morning Rush (7-9 AM):

  • I-10/I-17 stacks are congested
  • Surface streets are often faster from the East Valley
  • Allow extra time

Evening Rush (4-6 PM):

  • Downtown empties toward freeways
  • 7th Street/7th Avenue can be alternatives
  • Significant backup toward Scottsdale

Event Day Considerations

When major events coincide:

  • D-backs home games create traffic
  • Arena concerts affect parking
  • First Fridays (monthly art walk) bring crowds
  • Plan accordingly
